description: Attaching and detaching a ROW ACCESS POLICY (all live-verified): the refusals are ordered (policy resolves, ON columns resolve, count matches, then the one-policy rule); re-attaching the SAME policy is refused (unlike masking); DROP ALL detaches (plural spelling only), DROP names must match the attached policy; the not-attached sentence says TABLE even for a view; the type rule spells both types with an unsized VARCHAR 128MB wide in a policy signature and FLOAT/NUMBER as different families; masked or projected columns cannot be policy arguments; the CREATE TABLE/VIEW clauses make the same checks (with CREATE's own unknown-column sentence); and a fully qualified policy from another database attaches. Converted 1:1 from ddl/RowAccessPolicyAttachmentTest (now retired).
